question: Which physical theory explains the generation of thrust by rocket engines, jet engines and deflating balloons?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Newton’s laws of motion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Newton's third law states that **"For every action, there is an equal but opposite reaction"**.

 
 
• Example: **Thrust generation in the rocket propulsion rocket engines, jet engines, and deflating balloons**.
 
 
 
• When burn-out fuel mixture is thrown in the back direction with high velocity then in the reaction a forward thrust is generated which pushes the rocket in a forward direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Newton’s First Law of Motion: 

__
 
• The first law is the law of Inertia.
 
• According to it, if a body is at rest will remain at rest, and if the body is in motion will remain in motion unless an external force is applied to it.
 
• An example is: The motion of a ball falling down through the atmosphere

Newtons Second Law:

 
• Newton's second law of motion is F = ma, where m is the mass of an object and a is the acceleration.
 
• It states that the "Rate of change of momentum of a body is equal to the external force applied to that body.
 
• An example of Newton's 2nd law is riding your bicycle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Faraday’s laws of electromagnetic induction**- It states that whenever a conductor is placed in a varying magnetic field, an electromotive force is induced.
 
• **Exclusion principle**- The principle states that in a single atom no two electrons will have an identical set or the same quantum numbers.
